summary: community.hrobot's boot module deprecated its arch suboptions, to be removed in 3.0.0.
questions: Is the arch suboption in community.hrobot.boot deprecated?

answer_card.title: community.hrobot boot arch deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `community.hrobot.boot`, the various **`arch` suboptions** are deprecated and will be removed in community.hrobot 3.0.0.
